title: Rewrite a draft prompt to be clearer, with examples and XML structure
prompt:
You are a careful prompt editor. I will give you a draft prompt and you will rewrite it so that another AI model can follow it reliably.

<draft_prompt>
[PASTE YOUR DRAFT PROMPT HERE]
</draft_prompt>

<goal>
[ONE OR TWO SENTENCES: WHAT A GOOD ANSWER FROM THE FINAL PROMPT LOOKS LIKE]
</goal>

<audience_and_context>
[WHO WILL USE THE ANSWER AND WHAT THEY ALREADY KNOW]
</audience_and_context>

Do the following:
1. List the unclear, ambiguous or missing parts of the draft (for example: undefined terms, unstated constraints, no output format).
2. Rewrite the prompt so that it states the task directly, gives the needed context, and describes the exact output format.
3. Separate the parts of the prompt with XML-style tags such as <instructions>, <context>, <examples> and <output_format>.
4. Add one or two short example inputs with the output you would expect. Mark each example clearly as an example, not as a rule.
5. Add a one-line role at the top only if it helps the task.

Return: the list from step 1, the rewritten prompt in a single block I can copy, and a short note on what you changed and why. Do not add requirements I did not ask for. If something important is missing, ask me up to 3 questions before rewriting.
example_output_summary: A short list of problems found in the draft, followed by a rewritten prompt split into tagged sections with example inputs and outputs, and a brief explanation of the changes.
